description: This file defines the 'LiteralDData' class, which provides access to distributed data of literal topics within the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes methods for creating instances based on an ActorSystem or an extension handler, as well as methods to obtain data readers, writers, and subscriptions.

classes.name: LiteralDData
classes.description: A final class that provides access to distributed data for literal topics, including methods for instantiation, obtaining readers/writers, and creating subscriptions.

classes.name: LiteralDData.Provider
classes.description: An abstract class serving as a provider for the distributed data extension, requiring implementation of configuration retrieval based on an ActorSystem.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an instance of LiteralDData using either an ActorSystem and Provider, or directly from a LiteralDDataHandler extension.

methods.name: getReader
methods.description: Returns the data reader for literal updates.

methods.name: getWriter
methods.description: Returns the data writer for literal updates.

methods.name: createSubscriptions
methods.description: Creates and returns subscriptions for literal updates.
